props.animation_script:
(async () => {


const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][RockYourWorld]";


const ANIM_KEY = "oni.rockYourWorld.slidePulse";


// =========================


// TUNING


// =========================


const MOVE_PX = 90; // how far the caster slides forward


const MOVE_MS = 260; // forward / backward slide duration


const HOLD_MS = 700; // how long to hold while VFX is visible


const VFX_SCALE = 3; // requested scale


const VFX_OFFSET_X = 0; // fine tune if needed


const VFX_OFFSET_Y = 0; // fine tune if needed


const SFX_DELAY_MS = MOVE_MS + 20;


const SFX_VOLUME = 0.9;


const VFX_FILE =


"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Template/Circle/OutPulse/OutPulse_01_Regular_BlueWhite_Burst_600x600.webm";


const SFX_FILE =


"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/success2.ogg";


const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));


try {


if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {


ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");


return;


}


if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {


ui.notifications.error("ONI Pseudo Animation API is not available.");


return;


}


// Ensure ONI.emit exists


globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};


if (!ONI.emit) {


ONI.emit = (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) => {


const { local = true, world = false } = options;


if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);


if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });


};


}


// -------------------------


// Resolve caster


// -------------------------


const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};


async function resolveTokenFromUuid(uuid) {


if (!uuid) return null;


const doc = await fromUuid(uuid);


return doc?.object ?? doc ?? null;


}


const sourceToken =


await resolveTokenFromUuid(


payload.attackerUuid ??


payload.sourceTokenUuid ??


payload.casterTokenUuid ??


payload.attackerTokenUuid ??


null


) ??


globalThis._token ??


canvas.tokens.controlled[0] ??


null;


if (!sourceToken) {


ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found for Rock your World animation.");


return;


}


const rawTargets = Array.isArray(payload.targets) ? payload.targets : [];


const targetIds = [];


for (const t of rawTargets) {


const td = await fromUuid(t).catch(() => null);


const tok = td?.object ?? td ?? null;


if (tok?.id) targetIds.push(tok.id);


}


// Forward direction:


// ally (1) usually stands on right -> slide left


// enemy (-1) usually stands on left -> slide right


// Friendly (1) = slide left

// Everything else = slide right

const disp = Number(sourceToken?.document?.disposition ?? 0);

const dx = disp === 1 ? -MOVE_PX : +MOVE_PX;


ONI.emit(


"oni:animationStart",


{


type: ANIM_KEY,


sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,


targetTokenIds: targetIds,


sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,


timestamp: Date.now()


},


{ local: true, world: false }


);


// -------------------------


// Pseudo script


// -------------------------


const PSEUDO_SCRIPT = String.raw`


const { casterToken, params } = ctx;


if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Missing casterToken");


function easeInOutCubic(t) {


return t < 0.5


? 4 * t * t * t


: 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;


}


function tweenXY(obj, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, durMs) {


return new Promise((resolve) => {


const start = performance.now();


const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;


const update = () => {


const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;


const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);


const e = easeInOutCubic(t);


obj.x = fromX + (toX - fromX) * e;


obj.y = fromY + (toY - fromY) * e;


if (t >= 1) {


ticker.remove(update);


resolve();


}


};


ticker.add(update);


});


}


async function makeTokenClone(token) {


const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;


const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);


const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);


sprite.anchor.set(0.5);


sprite.x = token.center.x;


sprite.y = token.center.y;


if (baseObj) {


sprite.width = Math.abs(baseObj.width ?? token.w ?? 100);


sprite.height = Math.abs(baseObj.height ?? token.h ?? 100);


sprite.rotation = baseObj.rotation ?? 0;


// preserve flip state


if ((baseObj.scale?.x ?? 1) < 0) sprite.scale.x *= -1;


if ((baseObj.scale?.y ?? 1) < 0) sprite.scale.y *= -1;


sprite.alpha = baseObj.alpha ?? 1;


}


sprite.zIndex = Number(params.cloneZ ?? 5000);


canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;


canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);


canvas.stage.sortChildren();


return sprite;


}


function tryPlayVideoTexture(texture) {


try {


const bt = texture?.baseTexture;


const candidates = [


bt?.resource?.source,


bt?.resource?.resource,


bt?.resource?.data?.source,


texture?.resource?.source


].filter(Boolean);


for (const media of candidates) {


if (typeof media.play === "function") {


media.currentTime = 0;


media.loop = false;


media.muted = true;


const maybePromise = media.play();


if (maybePromise?.catch) maybePromise.catch(() => {});


return;


}


}


} catch (_) {}


}


async function makeVfxSprite(x, y, refSprite) {


const tex = await loadTexture(params.vfxFile);


tryPlayVideoTexture(tex);


const fx = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);


fx.anchor.set(0.5);


fx.x = x + Number(params.vfxOffsetX ?? 0);


fx.y = y + Number(params.vfxOffsetY ?? 0);


const texW = Math.max(1, tex.width || 600);


const texH = Math.max(1, tex.height || 600);


const refSize = Math.max(


Math.abs(refSprite?.width ?? casterToken.w ?? 100),


Math.abs(refSprite?.height ?? casterToken.h ?? 100)


);


// scale relative to token size


const baseScale = refSize / Math.max(texW, texH);


const finalScale = baseScale * Number(params.vfxScale ?? 1);


fx.scale.set(finalScale);


fx.alpha = 1;


fx.zIndex = Number(params.vfxZ ?? 5100);


// nice additive look for magical burst


try { fx.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.SCREEN; } catch (_) {}


canvas.stage.addChild(fx);


canvas.stage.sortChildren();


return fx;


}


const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;


const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;


const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;


let clone = null;


let vfx = null;


try {


clone = await makeTokenClone(casterToken);


// hide real token locally during pseudo move


if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;


casterToken.visible = false;


const homeX = clone.x;


const homeY = clone.y;


const frontX = homeX + Number(params.dx ?? 0);


const frontY = homeY;


// slide forward


await tweenXY(


clone,


homeX, homeY,


frontX, frontY,


Number(params.moveMs ?? 260)


);


// VFX on caster at front position


vfx = await makeVfxSprite(clone.x, clone.y, clone);


// hold while VFX is shown


await wait(Number(params.holdMs ?? 700));


// cleanup VFX before moving back


if (vfx) {


if (vfx.parent) vfx.parent.removeChild(vfx);


vfx.destroy();


vfx = null;


}


// slide back


await tweenXY(


clone,


frontX, frontY,


homeX, homeY,


Number(params.moveMs ?? 260)


);


} finally {


if (vfx) {


if (vfx.parent) vfx.parent.removeChild(vfx);


vfx.destroy();


}


if (clone) {


if (clone.parent) clone.parent.removeChild(clone);


clone.destroy();


}


if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;


casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;


}


`;


// total wait window for the cinematic


const totalMs = MOVE_MS + HOLD_MS + MOVE_MS + 80;


// Fire pseudo animation


const pseudoRun = Promise.resolve(


game.ONI.pseudo.play({


scriptId: "oni.rockYourWorld.slidePulse",


scriptSource: PSEUDO_SCRIPT,


casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,


targetTokenUuids: [],


params: {


dx,


moveMs: MOVE_MS,


holdMs: HOLD_MS,


vfxFile: VFX_FILE,


vfxScale: VFX_SCALE,


vfxOffsetX: VFX_OFFSET_X,


vfxOffsetY: VFX_OFFSET_Y,


cloneZ: 5000,


vfxZ: 5100


},


meta: { source: "Rock your World" }


})


);


// SFX timed to start when the VFX appears


const sfxRun = new Sequence()


.wait(SFX_DELAY_MS)


.sound()


.file(SFX_FILE)


.volume(SFX_VOLUME)


.play();


// Wait for the whole cinematic window


await Promise.all([


pseudoRun,


sfxRun,


sleep(totalMs)


]);


} catch (err) {


console.error(TAG, "Animation crashed:", err);


} finally {


try {


const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};


const sourceUuid =


payload.attackerUuid ??


payload.sourceTokenUuid ??


payload.casterTokenUuid ??


payload.attackerTokenUuid ??


null;


let sourceToken = null;


if (sourceUuid) {


const doc = await fromUuid(sourceUuid).catch(() => null);


sourceToken = doc?.object ?? doc ?? null;


}


sourceToken = sourceToken ?? globalThis._token ?? canvas.tokens.controlled[0] ?? null;


ONI.emit(


"oni:animationEnd",


{


type: ANIM_KEY,


sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null,


targetTokenIds: [],


sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,


timestamp: Date.now()


},


{ local: true, world: false }


);


} catch (_) {}


}


})();
props.custom_logic_action:
const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][ROCK-YOUR-WORLD]";


const FLAG_SCOPE = "world";


const FLAG_KEY = "rockYourWorld_choice";


const BUFFS = [


{


id: "strong",


label: "Strong",


effectUuid: "Item.0rfKFWTyPt7TfUvl.ActiveEffect.SNtz75qDr9oLQmLI"


},


{


id: "swift",


label: "Swift",


effectUuid: "Item.0rfKFWTyPt7TfUvl.ActiveEffect.foMQpdHKjia9gJ03"


},


{


id: "awake",


label: "Awake",


effectUuid: "Item.0rfKFWTyPt7TfUvl.ActiveEffect.4aZ4IDuT9N2KonEr"


},


{


id: "focus",


label: "Focus",


effectUuid: "Item.0rfKFWTyPt7TfUvl.ActiveEffect.xuulC26tmB3n2wLT"


}


];


const p = __PAYLOAD;


if (!p) return context.cancelPipeline("Missing __PAYLOAD.");


const attackerUuid = p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? "";


const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(attackerUuid);


const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;


if (!attackerActor) return context.cancelPipeline("Missing attacker actor.");


const tokenDoc =


attackerDoc?.documentName === "Token"


? attackerDoc


: attackerDoc?.token?.document ?? attackerDoc?.token ?? null;


const fallbackSceneTokenDoc =


canvas?.tokens?.placeables?.find(t => t.actor?.id === attackerActor.id)?.document ?? null;


const disposition = Number(


tokenDoc?.disposition ??


fallbackSceneTokenDoc?.disposition ??


_token?.document?.disposition ??


0


) || 0;


// Friendly = prefer owning player


const ownerPlayers = game.users.contents.filter(u =>


!u.isGM &&


attackerActor.testUserPermission?.(u, CONST.DOCUMENT_OWNERSHIP_LEVELS.OWNER)


);


const preferredPlayerOwner =


ownerPlayers.find(u => u.active) ??


ownerPlayers[0] ??


null;


// Enemy = GM


const gmUser =


game.users.activeGM ??


game.users.contents.find(u => u.isGM && u.active) ??


game.users.contents.find(u => u.isGM) ??


null;


let intendedChooser = game.user;


if (disposition === -1) {


intendedChooser = gmUser ?? game.user;


} else if (disposition === 1) {


intendedChooser = preferredPlayerOwner ?? game.user;


}


// Safety gate:


// - Enemy-side choice should be handled by GM


// - Friendly-side choice should be handled by owning player


// - GM fallback is allowed for friendly actors in testing / no active owner situations


const currentUserCanChoose =


game.user.id === intendedChooser?.id ||


(game.user.isGM && disposition === 1);


if (!currentUserCanChoose) {


return context.cancelPipeline(


`Rock your World must be chosen by ${intendedChooser?.name ?? "the correct user"}.`


);


}


const bodyHtml = `








Choose 1 buff for all targets:










Strong






Swift






Awake






Focus












`;


const pick = await context.ui.chooseButtons({

  title: "Rock your World",

  bodyHtml,

  choices: BUFFS.map(buff => ({

    id: buff.id,

    label: buff.label,

    value: buff

  }))

});


if (!pick?.value?.effectUuid) {

  return context.cancelPipeline("Rock your World was cancelled.");

}


const chosen = {


...pick.value,


skillName: context?.skillName ?? "Rock your World",


attackerUuid,


attackerActorId: attackerActor.id,


attackerActorName: attackerActor.name,


disposition,


chosenByUserId: game.user.id,


chosenByUserName: game.user.name,


chosenAt: Date.now()


};


// Constant slot on the caster actor: newest choice replaces older choice


await attackerActor.setFlag(FLAG_SCOPE, FLAG_KEY, chosen);


// Mirror into payload meta so the same action can resolve safely on GM side


p.meta = p.meta || {};


p.meta.rockYourWorldChoice = chosen;


p.meta.rockYourWorldFlagScope = FLAG_SCOPE;


p.meta.rockYourWorldFlagKey = FLAG_KEY;


console.log(TAG, "CHOICE STORED", {


attacker: attackerActor.name,


disposition,


chooser: game.user.name,


chosen


});


ui.notifications.info(`${attackerActor.name} chose ${chosen.label}.`);
props.custom_logic_resolution:
const TAG = "[CL-RES][ROCK-YOUR-WORLD]";

const DEFAULT_FLAG_SCOPE = "world";

const DEFAULT_FLAG_KEY = "rockYourWorld_choice";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

const attackerUuid = p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? "";

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(attackerUuid);

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!attackerActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing attacker actor.");

return;

}

// Prefer the live payload copy first, then fall back to the constant stored slot

const storedChoice =

p?.meta?.rockYourWorldChoice ??

attackerActor.getFlag(

p?.meta?.rockYourWorldFlagScope ?? DEFAULT_FLAG_SCOPE,

p?.meta?.rockYourWorldFlagKey ?? DEFAULT_FLAG_KEY

);

if (!storedChoice?.effectUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "No stored Rock your World choice found.");

return;

}

const sourceEffectDoc = await fromUuid(storedChoice.effectUuid);

if (!sourceEffectDoc) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve source Active Effect UUID:", storedChoice.effectUuid);

return;

}

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

if (!targetUuids.length) {

console.warn(TAG, "No targets found.");

return;

}

const baseEffectData = sourceEffectDoc.toObject();

delete baseEffectData._id;

delete baseEffectData.id;

baseEffectData.origin = storedChoice.effectUuid;

baseEffectData.transfer = false;

baseEffectData.disabled = false;

baseEffectData.flags = foundry.utils.deepClone(baseEffectData.flags ?? {});

baseEffectData.flags.world = foundry.utils.deepClone(baseEffectData.flags.world ?? {});

baseEffectData.flags.world.rockYourWorld = {

choiceId: storedChoice.id,

label: storedChoice.label,

sourceEffectUuid: storedChoice.effectUuid,

sourceActorUuid: attackerActor.uuid,

sourceActorName: attackerActor.name,

appliedAt: Date.now()

};

let appliedCount = 0;

for (const targetUuid of targetUuids) {

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(targetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Skipping unresolved target:", targetUuid);

continue;

}

// Refresh same buff instead of stacking duplicates

const existing = targetActor.effects.filter(e => {

const mark = e.getFlag("world", "rockYourWorld") ?? {};

return (

e.origin === storedChoice.effectUuid ||

(mark?.choiceId === storedChoice.id &&

mark?.sourceActorUuid === attackerActor.uuid) ||

e.name === sourceEffectDoc.name

);

});

if (existing.length) {

await targetActor.deleteEmbeddedDocuments(

"ActiveEffect",

existing.map(e => e.id)

);

}

const effectData = foundry.utils.deepClone(baseEffectData);

const created = await targetActor.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [effectData]);

appliedCount += created.length;

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", {

target: targetActor.name,

choice: storedChoice.label,

effectName: effectData.name

});

}

console.log(TAG, "DONE", {

attacker: attackerActor.name,

choice: storedChoice.label,

targetCount: targetUuids.length,

appliedCount

});

ui.notifications.info(`Rock your World applied ${storedChoice.label} to ${appliedCount} target(s).`);
